title: Aftermath
description: Plan-vs-reality comparison between a pre-mortem prediction and the actual practice conversation.

summary.description: One- or two-sentence read on whether the user got what they came for.

scenario_outcomes.description: One entry per predicted pre-mortem scenario, in the same order (scenario_id 1, 2, 3).

title.description: Copied verbatim from the predicted scenario.

evidence.description: Short transcript-grounded evidence the scenario materialized. Empty string when match_quality is 'did_not_occur'.

notes.description: Plain-English read on what the prediction got right and what it missed for this scenario.

unforeseen_moments.description: Things that actually happened in the round but the pre-mortem did NOT predict. Empty array is valid.

turn.description: Optional. 1-based index into the USER turns where this surfaced.

prediction_accuracy.description: How well the pre-mortem matched reality overall. 1.0 = every scenario landed as predicted; 0.0 = none of them did.

next_round_focus.description: Single-sentence guidance for what the next practice round should target, based on this comparison.
